svg.aria-label: Coin cell wiring: green and blue to the positive case; white, red and orange to the negative cap. A four-wire holder has one current contact and one sense contact on each face. With alligator clips, clip only the centers of the two flat faces; a clip biting the rim shorts the positive and negative terminals.
